ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_delta_z_cost_interaction_weighted_logmeanexp_v2_repaired
ir.intuition: This loss weights the log probability difference by an interaction of sigmoid(delta_z) and relu(cost_gap), clamping cost_gap and intermediate values to ensure numerical stability, then applies a weighted log-mean-exponential aggregation.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-12
cost_gap_nonneg = relu(cost_gap.clamp(min=0))
interaction = sigmoid(delta_z) * cost_gap_nonneg
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scaled_diff = interaction * diff
exp_arg = -scaled_diff
exp_clamped = exp(exp_arg).clamp(min=eps)
weighted_exp = weight * exp_clamped
sum_weighted_exp = sum(weighted_exp).clamp(min=eps)
sum_weight = sum(weight).clamp(min=eps)
logmeanexp = log(sum_weighted_exp) - log(sum_weight)
loss = logmeanexp.mean()
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-12
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    delta_z = batch["delta_z"]
    cost_gap_raw = batch["cost_gap"]
    cost_gap = ops.relu(cost_gap_raw.clamp(min=0))
    weight = batch["weight"]

    interaction = ops.mul(ops.sigmoid(delta_z), cost_gap)
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(interaction, diff)

    exp_arg = ops.neg(ops.clamp(scaled_diff, max=100))
    exp_clamped = ops.exp(exp_arg).clamp(min=eps)
    weighted_exp = ops.mul(weight, exp_clamped)

    sum_weighted_exp = ops.sum(weighted_exp).clamp(min=eps)
    sum_weight = ops.sum(weight).clamp(min=eps)

    logmeanexp = ops.log(sum_weighted_exp) - ops.log(sum_weight)
    return logmeanexp.mean()
